local p = {}

local OTHER_LANGUAGES = {
	{ prefix = 'cn', code = "zh-Hans", label = 'Simplified Chinese'},
	{ prefix = 'tc', code = "zh-Hant", label = 'Traditional Chinese'},
	{ prefix = 'jp', code = "ja", label = 'Japanese'},
	{ prefix = 'kr', code = "ko", label = 'Korean'},
	{ prefix = 'sp', code = "es", label = 'Spanish'},
	{ prefix = 'ru', code = "ru", label = 'Russian'},
	{ prefix = 'de', code = "de", label = 'German'},
	{ prefix = 'fr', code = "fr", label = 'French'},
	{ prefix = 'id', code = "id", label = 'Indonesian'},
	{ prefix = 'it', code = "it", label = 'Italian'},
	{ prefix = 'pt', code = "pt", label = 'Portuguese'},
	{ prefix = 'th', code = "th", label = 'Thai'},
	{ prefix = 'vi', code = "vi", label = 'Vietnamese'},
}

function p.onCastArgsStart(args, sep, kind)
end

function p.onCastArgsEnd(args, sep, kind)
	for i, section in ipairs(args.sections) do
		if section == 'OtherLanguagesSection' or section == 'In Other Languages' then
			args[section] = {}
			args[section..'_collapsed'] = true
			args[section..'_label'] = 'In Other Languages'
			for i, lang in ipairs(OTHER_LANGUAGES) do
				local prefix = lang.prefix
				local label = lang.label
				local code = lang.code
				if prefix == 'cn' and not args['tcname'] then
					label = 'Chinese'
					code = 'zh'
				end
				local key = prefix .. 'name'
				if args[key] then
					args[key..'_label'] = label
					args[key] = string.format('<span lang="%s">%s</span>', code, args[key])
				end
				args[section][i] = key
			end
		end
	end
end

return p
